text:
dmitri: Saw a p99 tail spike on streaming pool after yesterday's kernel-selector update. p50 fine, p95 a little up, but p99 jumped ~120ms.
ankit: which selector change? the fused-attn prefer-for-small-mb flag?
sara: yep — kernel-selector v2 started preferring fused kernels for mb_size <= 8 to get steady-state wins. we expected no regressions.
dmitri: repro on canary: streaming chat with cold KV misses shows large tail when mb_size=4. non-streaming completions don't reproduce.
liz: interesting — fused kernel probably changes memory access order and causes bigger init + memcpy work on first KV fills. do we have profiler output?
ankit: uploading now. profiler highlights a ~90ms stall inside memcpy + kernel_init on a subset of calls; correlates with seq_len>512 and mb_size<=4.
mike (infra-bot): perf dump uploaded -> s3://perf-dumps/2012345678/dmitri-canary-03-00.tar.gz
sara: thanks. hypothesis: fused kernels win for long steady token loops, but on short microbatches they increase one-off init cost (amortization problem). streaming traffic has many short bursts and more KV coldness.
dmitri: completions batch more tokens + warm KV, so init cost is amortized — hence no p99 bump there.
ankit: quick mitigation idea: conditional kernel routing. If streaming_mode && mb_size <= 6 && kv_cold_flag -> route to legacy kernel for that request. Rollout behind feature flag.
liz: SGTM. gate by trace id and do a gradual canary across a few hosts. add metrics for migrated fraction.
sara: will add flag + metric hooks: p50/p95/p99 for streaming, memcpy time, kernel_init time, and a histogram of mb_size.
qa-bot: test plan: 1) measure p99 on canary vs baseline for chat streams; 2) ensure bulk completions throughput unaffected; 3) observe CPU/GPU utilization delta.
ankit: also capture kv_hit_ratio and mb_size distribution to refine heuristic later.
dmitri: timeline — can we flip the flag in 30m to collect 1–2 hours of traces before EOD?
sara: deploying to canary in ~20m. @ankit will watch profiler.
ankit: initial canary results (40m after flip): streaming p99 reduced from +120ms to +20ms. p95/p50 slightly up (~+10ms) but within SLO. completions unchanged.
sara: good. plan: expand to +20 hosts if stable, then iterate on selector heuristics to prefer fused only when it's net-positive.
liz: add alert rule: if streaming p99 > baseline + 50ms during rollout, auto-disable new selector and notify runtime oncall.
ankit: adding a selector knob: prefer_fused_when = (kv_hit_rate > 0.8) && (mb_size >= 6) && (seq_len < 1024).
dmitri: long-term we should profile fused kernel init path to remove the one-off memcpy stall instead of relying on fallback. file an infra/rls task.
sara: created ticket #INF-4982 to investigate fused kernel init optimization and KV alignment.
ankit: follow-up: we'll also emit per-request tag if we forced legacy kernel so downstream can reconcile latency traces.
mike (infra-bot): note: dump contains full flamegraphs + raw nvprof traces.
ankit: action items: 1) Sara: feature flag + metrics + rollout PR; 2) Ankit: mb histogram + kv hit telemetry; 3) Dmitri: validate p99 reduction and confirm no regressions on other workloads; 4) Liz: add alert; 5) deeper perf ticket assigned.
dmitri: thanks — happy to pair on deeper profiling tomorrow.
sara: rolling to +20 hosts now. will update thread with 2h snapshot.

--- PERF SNAPSHOT (post-canary) ---
- p50 (streaming): +8ms vs baseline
- p95 (streaming): +22ms vs baseline
- p99 (streaming): +120ms -> +20ms when legacy forced
- non-streaming completions: no statistically significant change
- root cause signal: memcpy+/kernel_init spike for mb_size <=4 and seq_len>512 (KV cold)

ankit: looks solved for now. leaving this thread open until INF-4982 lands and we replace heuristic with a robust selector that uses live KV hit signals.
qa-bot: will run regression suite tomorrow at 02:00 UTC.
sara: thanks everyone. syncing these notes into the runtime retro doc and runtime standup tomorrow.
